editorial.intro: Walmart shopping scenes feature grocery totes, stocked carts, delivery illustrations and blue and yellow retail concepts.
paragraphs: Blue shopping bags and yellow spark symbols connect the grocery scenes in this Walmart clipart collection. Filled carts, household supplies and illustrated shoppers appear beside parcel deliveries and imagined retail counters and equipment.

The {{artworkCount}} artworks mix colorful store scenes with black and white shopping outlines. A delivery cyclist, a puppy beside a small cart, a teddy bear among toys and a mobility scooter add people, animals and everyday objects to the selection.

editorial.intro: AbbVie themed laboratory scenes feature microscopes, sample handling, imagined instruments and illustrated researchers in navy and purple.
paragraphs: Navy equipment and purple sample tubes set the scene for this AbbVie clipart collection. Researchers hold tubes, use pipettes, examine a vial and work at microscopes beside imagined instruments with glass chambers, trays and control panels.

The {{artworkCount}} color and black and white drawings also feature laboratory notebooks, protective glasses and glassware. A smiling sample carrying robot and imagined research buildings with purple planting add playful and architectural subjects to the bench scenes.

editorial.intro: Alphabet and Google illustrations bring together recognizable service symbols, device families and imagined technology scenes.
paragraphs: Multicolor service symbols meet everyday technology scenes in this Alphabet and Google clipart collection. Readers, travelers, teachers and callers appear with recognizable maps, mail, documents and search motifs.

The {{artworkCount}} color and black and white artworks include Pixel family devices, Android characters and desk arrangements. Imagined research equipment, vehicles and a delivery aircraft bring larger technology concepts into the collection alongside familiar screens and illustrated people.

editorial.intro: Amazon parcels, delivery scenes and recognizable device families appear alongside playful characters and imagined logistics technology.
paragraphs: The parcel smile connects doorstep deliveries, packing benches and household devices in this Amazon clipart collection. Couriers carry boxes and customers receive parcels beside Kindle, Echo, Fire TV, Blink, Ring and eero devices.

Among the {{artworkCount}} color and black and white drawings are a grocery tote, a curious dog and a cheerful parcel character. Delivery vehicles share the collection with imagined sorting machines, shopping equipment and communications devices.

editorial.intro: AMD branded processors, computer hardware concepts and workshop scenes combine red accents, exposed components and playful chip characters.
paragraphs: Silver processors and red accented hardware give this AMD clipart collection its computer theme. Component closeups sit beside open cases, cooling units, graphics card concepts and imagined workstations with exposed circuit boards.

The {{artworkCount}} drawings mix color with black and white assembly scenes. Technicians hold a motherboard and carry a server, tweezers lift a processor, and cheerful chip characters hold a game controller or ride a skateboard among the hardware.

editorial.intro: Chevron signs, fuel pumps, tankers and industrial equipment appear alongside workers, workshop supplies and maritime scenes.
paragraphs: Red and blue emblems connect fuel pumps, work clothing and industrial equipment in this Chevron clipart collection. Caltex and Texaco signs appear beside service station scenes, while workers present a tablet and inspect a pressure gauge.

The {{artworkCount}} color and black and white artworks cover road tankers, rail and marine transport, refinery towers and workshop supplies. Tool outlines and an imagined smiling fuel pump character add smaller subjects among the larger transport and workplace scenes.

editorial.intro: Cisco networking illustrations feature cable layouts, switches, wireless symbols and imagined connected equipment.
paragraphs: Blue patch cables link switches, racks and office devices in this Cisco clipart collection. Technicians handle connectors and cable tools beside wireless symbols, server cabinets and imagined networking equipment.

The {{artworkCount}} drawings range from colorful campus scenes and a Webex themed terminal to black and white network diagrams. Security device concepts and unusual connected machines sit alongside tidy cable arrangements, office desks and equipment cases.

editorial.intro: Coca Cola bottles and cans share the gallery with picnic coolers, diner accessories, seasonal details and imagined drinks equipment.
paragraphs: Contour bottles and red cans meet picnic baskets, ice coolers and diner counters in this Coca Cola clipart collection. Other drawings show a smiling waiter carrying a drinks tray, a playful polar bear hugging a bottle, food pairings and seasonal arrangements.

The {{artworkCount}} drawings also include bottle carriers, scarves and bows, a thermometer sign and black and white accessories. Imagined vending machines and soda fountains add polished metal fittings and retro shapes to the drink scenes.

editorial.intro: Lilly script marks connect illustrated scientists, laboratory glassware, sample handling scenes and clearly imagined medicine packaging and equipment.
paragraphs: Scientists pipette, examine samples and write notes at laboratory benches in this Eli Lilly clipart collection. Glassware, sample racks and anatomy themed displays accompany the people, with red script appearing across coats and equipment.

The {{artworkCount}} images range from colorful research scenes and a smiling flask character to black and white laboratory drawings. Imagined medicine containers, buildings and equipment sit beside microscopes, protective clothing, sample bottles and a scientist washing their hands.

Across the {{artworkCount}} drawings, colorful equipment arrangements alternate with black and white hose reels, core sample benches and loading structures. Imagined service stations, offshore platforms and industrial machines add larger scenes beside tool carts and a smiling red drop character.

editorial.intro: Johnson & Johnson illustrations pair laboratory scenes and anatomical displays with imagined medical equipment in red and white.
paragraphs: Scientists hold sample trays, use pipettes and examine vials in this Johnson & Johnson clipart collection. Microscopes and tube racks fill the laboratory benches, while heart, eye and joint displays bring anatomical shapes into the red and white scenes.

The {{artworkCount}} drawings include a doctor speaking with a visitor, protective clothing, instrument cases and black and white laboratory objects. Imagined medical robots, enclosed instruments and research buildings sit alongside notebooks, glassware and a flask drying rack.

editorial.intro: JPMorganChase themed drawings combine navy office objects, symbolic finance scenes and imagined bank branches.
paragraphs: Navy portfolios, office desks and miniature storefronts shape this JPMorganChase clipart collection. Illustrated people write notes, meet across counters, use payment terminals and pack boxes beside symbolic keys, globes and balance scales.

The {{artworkCount}} artworks include colorful banking scenes, document cases and black and white desk objects. Imagined branches and digital banking devices join silver vault doors, shopping counters, travel cases and symbolic shields in the navy and cream palette.

editorial.intro: Micron Technology illustrations feature memory modules, storage drives, patterned wafers, cleanroom workers and imagined semiconductor equipment.
paragraphs: Memory modules, patterned wafers and storage drives meet cleanroom and workbench scenes in this Micron Technology clipart collection. Dark chip rows and gold contacts distinguish the component closeups.

The {{artworkCount}} color and black and white images include wafer carriers, handling tools and technicians working at benches. A playful chip character joins imagined computing equipment, while circuit boards and carefully arranged components give the hardware scenes different shapes.

editorial.intro: NVIDIA themed artwork combines graphics cards and chip handling scenes with black and green computing, robotics and visualization concepts.
paragraphs: Graphics cards and green circuit details appear with engineers, artists and semiconductor scenes in this NVIDIA clipart collection. Green accents run across computer towers, circuit boards and illustrated workspaces.

The {{artworkCount}} color illustrations and black and white outlines include hardware closeups and laboratory workstations. Imagined delivery robots, flying machines and vehicles add playful forms beside people working at screens and benches.

editorial.intro: Palantir themed illustrations turn data networks and software ideas into teal consoles, diagrams, machinery concepts and collaborative desk scenes.
paragraphs: Teal data networks connect diagrams, planning desks and industry scenes in this Palantir clipart collection. Analysts gather around tablets and shared displays, while imagined machines give software themes a visible shape.

The {{artworkCount}} color illustrations and black and white outlines include dashboards, robot concepts and network symbols. Collaborative work scenes alternate with control rooms and individual desk arrangements, with teal accents linking people, screens and equipment.

editorial.intro: SpaceX illustrations span Falcon rockets, Dragon capsules, Starship designs, recovery scenes and clearly labeled spaceflight concepts.
paragraphs: Rockets and Dragon capsules share this SpaceX clipart collection with astronauts, workshop tools and Starlink dishes. Launch towers and recovery cranes stand beside spacecraft views and a child holding a model rocket.

The {{artworkCount}} illustrations combine colorful spaceflight scenes with black and white equipment outlines and playful characters. Imagined lunar, Mars and orbital refueling concepts bring distant landscapes and connected spacecraft into the selection.

editorial.intro: Visa cards and contactless symbols appear with wallets, travel props, checkout scenes and imagined payment devices in a blue, cream and gold palette.
paragraphs: Cards, wallets and rolling suitcases bring a travel theme to this Visa clipart collection. Blue, cream and gold details link shop counters and illustrated travelers with imagined payment devices and friendly card characters.

The {{artworkCount}} color and black and white images include checkout scenes, travel accessories and small business settings. People hold cards beside their luggage or work at counters, while card closeups and compact object arrangements provide simpler compositions.
